`business-v1.2-golden.json` was generated by executing the published v1.2
`desktop/store.cjs` and `desktop/business.cjs` at commit
`98f56dba6138280b64a7ea57c02b91b73a268b8a`, with the clock fixed to
`2026-10-17T12:00:00.000Z`. All names, addresses and work records are test data.

The fixture records the workspace before billing, invoice-create payload, draft,
sent invoice with a partial payment, complete and single-day financial reports,
exact escaped HTML, BigInt money rounding examples, and the baseline ICU formats
for all 162 supported currency codes. The Rust tests execute the port against
these outputs. Random invoice identity is ignored only when comparing a newly
created draft; the invoice number and every accounting field remain checked.

No JavaScript runtime is required to run the Rust tests or application.
